caption:
Worried about tomorrow? Trust your affairs to Allah

Allah is the Lord of the east and the west; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, and He tells us to take Him as the Disposer of our affairs. Hand Him what you cannot carry tonight.

Surah Al-Muzzammil 73:9

Name one worry you will leave with Allah before you sleep.

#tawakkul #surahmuzzammil #worry #sundaynight

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
